title: Vampire Vape Base Mix 50VG/50PG 100ml
description: Making your own e-liquid couldn’t be simpler with Vampire Vape Base Mix 50VG/50PG 100ml. It’s perfect balance of 50% Vegetable Glycerin (VG) and 50% Propylene Glycol (PG) provides the best of both ingredients and delivers a smooth, satisfying throat hit and great flavour. 50/50 e-liquid lends itself best to low-powered devices like starter kits and pods. This 100ml bottle will create a long-lasting shortfill, with the addition of your choice of flavour concentrates and nicotine shot (if required).
